title: CSS Text Spacing
text:
CSS
Text Spacing



CSS Text Spacing

CSS has several properties to control text spacing.

In this chapter you will learn about the following properties:

text-indent

letter-spacing

line-height

word-spacing

white-space

CSS Text Indentation

The CSS
text-indent
property is used to specify the indentation of the first line
in a text-block.

Tip:
Negative values are allowed. The first line will be
indented to the left if the value is negative.

CSS Letter Spacing

The CSS
letter-spacing
property is used to specify the space between the characters in a text.

Tip:
Negative values are allowed.

CSS Line Height

The CSS
line-height
property is used to specify the space between lines.

Note:
Negative values are not allowed.

CSS Word Spacing

The CSS
word-spacing
property is used to specify the space between
the words in a text.

Tip:
Negative values are allowed.

CSS White Space

The CSS
white-space
property specifies how white-space inside an element is handled.

This property can have one of the following values:

normal

nowrap

pre

pre-line

pre-wrap

The CSS Text Spacing Properties

Property

Description

letter-spacing

Specifies the space between characters in a text

line-height

Specifies the line height

text-indent

Specifies the indentation of the first line in a text-block

white-space

Specifies how to handle white-space inside an element

word-spacing

Specifies the space between words in a text
